_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so a Defense extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes + active diagnosis ids (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53 pattern). In Defense the CONDITION-CODES never textually equal an activation.diagnosticTrigger (activation triggers are FREE-TEXT phrases like 'Force readiness degradation'); this table bridges them.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(defense-pulse-engine.js inline classify, L149-171)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-semantics, L181-193)--> diagnosis id --(defense.json issues[]._authored||circuits)--> circuit nodeIds --(those nodeIds are activations whose diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT phrases)--> diagnosticTriggers. The diagnoses section is the strongest link (pure data, no family hop). The conditionCodes section adds the pulse-engine family hop and is WEAK for Defense (see heterogeneityVsFinance).
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual code gate, which is requiredFamilies with OR-semantics, L181-193, NOT primaryIndicators). A condition that only matches a diagnosis secondaryConfirmation token is NOT folded (secondaryConfirmation is DECLARED but never consumed by the engine's requiredFamilies gate).
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from defense.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsFinance: STRUCTURALLY WEAKER than Finance. (1) In Finance the condition-codes ARE the contract indicator tokens and a bespoke classify switch mapped each to its own family; the pulse engine then folded them tightly. In Defense the classify switch (L149-171) is DOMAIN-GENERIC, education-derived boilerplate (tokens: credential_devaluation, pedagogical_mismatch, digital_divide, admissions-style equity_failure). It does NOT emit ANY of the domain-specific families the Defense contracts require (conflict_event, cyber_event, strategic_analysis_event, defense_industry_event). (2) The ONLY family the classifier emits that ANY contract consumes is news_event, emitted solely by {digital_divide, platform_transition, pedagogical_mismatch, automation_displacement, adaptive_failure}. Because news_event is a shared requiredFamily of ALL SIX contracts, those 5 generic tokens trip ALL SIX diagnoses INDISCRIMINATELY — a boilerplate artifact, not a defense signal. (3) The contracts' own primaryIndicators (invasion, cyber_breach, nuclear_escalation, ...) are DECLARED but the classifier NEVER maps them to a family, so they emit no evidence (see unmapped.contractIndicatorsNeverClassified). (4) The conditions the Defense brain realistically emits (defense_high_stress, structural_stress) map to structural_event, which NO contract requires -> the condition path is effectively INERT for Defense; diagnoses activate via external dx.active (with INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE, catchAllBlocked:false, the only catch-all-eligible one). (5) Like Finance, macro_shock->macro_event is a dead-end. (6) Unlike Finance (whose activation.diagnosticTriggers ARE diagnosis ids and self-match), Defense activation.diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT (Energy-like), so the diagnoses map is FULLY load-bearing, not redundant. (7) Orphan count: Energy 1, Finance 3, Defense 6.

conditionCodes.reason: defense-pulse-engine.js classifies macro_shock -> [macro_event] (L170), but NO EVIDENCE_CONTRACT lists macro_event in requiredFamilies. It IS listed as secondaryConfirmation for INVASION and NUCLEAR_THREAT, but secondaryConfirmation is DECLARED and never consumed by the requiredFamilies OR-gate (L181-193). Dead-end family: reaches no diagnosis, no circuit, no activation. Same finding as Finance macro_shock.

classify -> [structural_event] (L169). NO contract requires structural_event. 'structural_stress' IS listed as secondaryConfirmation for INTELLIGENCE_FAILURE and CIVIL_UNREST, but secondaryConfirmation is not consumed by the requiredFamilies gate, and the emitted FAMILY (structural_event) differs from the token (structural_stress). These are the conditions the Defense brain most plausibly emits at runtime, so the condition->diagnosis path is effectively INERT for Defense; diagnoses fire via external dx.active instead.

(These are education-boilerplate tokens; institutional_event is co-emitted with news_event ONLY by the digital_divide branch, which is why that branch — not these — is the one grounded path.)

classify -> [indicator_event, policy_event] (L157-160). NO Defense contract requires either. No grounded link.

contractIndicatorsNeverClassified.reason: THE KEY DEFENSE HETEROGENEITY. Every one of these is a primaryIndicator (or secondaryConfirmation) declared in an EVIDENCE_CONTRACT, yet the pulse-engine classify switch (L149-171) NEVER maps any of them to an evidence family. They are declared-but-dead: a diagnosis can only satisfy hasRequiredEvidence via the generic classifier's families, none of which correspond to these defense-specific tokens. Analogous to Finance's contractOnlyTokensNotClassified (REFINERY_ATTACK/SANCTIONS in Energy), but FAR larger: in Defense the ENTIRE domain-specific indicator vocabulary is unclassified. No alias can be grounded on them.
